theorems.name: Submission.weighted_mono_local_data
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (U : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (H : Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ) (h : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (ξ : Ambient n ℓ) (ρ : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ (V.tangentSpace x).starProjection) V.weight → IsOpen U → LocallyIntegrableOn H U V.weight → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 h U → tsupport h ∩ closedBall ξ ρ ⊆ U → 0 < ρ → ∃ R A : ℝ, ρ < R ∧ tsupport h ∩ closedBall ξ R ⊆ U ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable h (V.weight.restrict (closedBall ξ R)) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable (V.normalRadialSq ξ) (V.weight.restrict (closedBall ξ R)) ∧ (∀ x ∈ closedBall ξ R, |h x| ≤ A ∧ |V.normalRadialSq ξ x| ≤ 1) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x ↦ inner ℝ (x - ξ) (V.tangentialGradient h x)) (closedBall ξ R) V.weight ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x ↦ inner ℝ (x - ξ) (V.tangentialGradient h x + h x • H x)) (closedBall ξ R) V.weight
